title: Structure-based virtual screening with AlphaFold identifies CLIP1-LTK inhibitors.
authors: Qu, Wang-Lin; Zhang, Xu-Jun; Wang, Gao-Ang; Tian, Wei-Xin; Chen, Kang; Ye, Yuan-Yi; Chen, Shi-Cheng; Hu, Ru-Bi; Liu, Yi-Fei; Shen, Chao; Li, Dan; Kang, Yu; Tian, Sheng; Teng, Peng; Hou, Ting-Jun; Pan, Pei-Chen
one_liner_zh: 该文利用AlphaFold预测蛋白结构进行虚拟筛选，发现CLIP1-LTK抑制剂，属于蛋白质结构预测在药物发现中的应用，方法创新性一般但问题和方法相关。
abstract: Artificial intelligence-based protein structure prediction provides new opportunities for structure-based drug discovery, especially for targets lacking experimental structures. Determining whether AlphaFold2- and AlphaFold3-derived models can reliably support structure-based virtual screening remains a critical issue. In this study, we systematically evaluated the applicability of AlphaFold2- and AlphaFold3-derived models for structure-based virtual screening and assessed the performance of different VS pipeline configurations that integrate AlphaFold models with diverse docking and scoring combinations. Based on our benchmarking results, we established a hierarchical VS methodology and applied this approach to CLIP1-LTK, an oncogenic fusion protein lacking an experimentally resolved structure. Using this pipeline, a library of approximately three million compounds was virtually screened, leading to the identification of potential inhibitor candidates. Similarity-based analog searching identified QL07, which exhibited an IC(50) value of 524.27 nM. QL07 inhibited CLIP1-LTK downstream signaling pathways and induced apoptosis in transformed Ba/F3-CLIP1-LTK cells. Furthermore, QL07 suppressed the growth of CLIP1-LTK-positive tumors in xenograft models. These findings underscore the utility of AlphaFold models in overcoming structural limitations in drug discovery and demonstrate their feasibility in identifying promising small-molecule inhibitors against protein targets without experimentally-determined structures.
abstract_zh: 基于人工智能的蛋白质结构预测为基于结构的药物发现提供了新的机遇，尤其是对于缺乏实验结构的靶标。确定AlphaFold2和AlphaFold3衍生的模型能否可靠支持基于结构的虚拟筛选仍是一个关键问题。在本研究中，我们系统评估了AlphaFold2和AlphaFold3衍生模型在基于结构的虚拟筛选中的适用性，并考察了将AlphaFold模型与多种对接和打分组合相结合的不同虚拟筛选流程配置的性能。基于我们的基准测试结果，我们建立了一种分层虚拟筛选方法，并将该方法应用于CLIP1-LTK，这是一种缺乏实验解析结构的致癌融合蛋白。利用该流程，对约三百万个化合物的文库进行了虚拟筛选，从而识别出潜在的抑制剂候选物。基于相似性的类似物搜索确定了QL07，其IC(50)值为524.27 nM。QL07抑制了CLIP1-LTK下游信号通路，并诱导转化的Ba/F3-CLIP1-LTK细胞凋亡。此外，QL07在异种移植模型中抑制了CLIP1-LTK阳性肿瘤的生长。这些发现强调了AlphaFold模型在克服药物发现中结构限制方面的实用性，并展示了其在针对无实验确定结构的蛋白质靶标识别有前景的小分子抑制剂方面的可行性。
